what: The section is (number of panels × 112.5 + 100)svh long. While the stage stays pinned to the screen, scroll progress divided by the number of panels gives one step per panel, and the split panels swap at each step. Earlier panels are stacked on top, so when the current one leaves, the large right-hand photo folds up toward its top edge over .5s linear and reveals the next photo laid out beneath. The left colour panel fills with its colour over .5s only while it is current (it switches off instantly when leaving). Photos sit at 1.1x and drift from 30px below to 30px above over 1.2s, and the small photo inside the colour panel unfolds from its bottom edge. At 767 and below there is no large photo, only the colour panels

options.per: Scroll used by one panel (svh), default 112.5 — with four, the section is 550svh
options.--fx-panel: Color per panel (item), set via style — use skin variables (var(--kf-ink) etc.)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: One panel (inside stage) — front panel on top
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Large photo frame on the right (in panel) — one child flows by
options.[data-fx-part=thumb]: Small photo frame inside the color panel (if any) — unfolds from the bottom edge
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text shown only for the current edition (small text above the title · button)
